about: The words of a failure when the command on the other machine gives no service line (src/remote.ts sshTrouble). stderr is what it writes on stderr; exit is its exit code, or null when it never ends and says nothing on stdout (the core gives up after its answer time). expect is {kind, message}; in the message, {given} is the machine as the owner wrote it.

cases.name: pine is not installed
cases.stderr: pine is not installed there: no pine command on its PATH.

expect.message: pine is not installed on {given}, or not on the PATH of its login shell. pine is not installed there: no pine command on its PATH.

cases.name: pine is not installed and the shell says nothing

expect.message: pine is not installed on {given}, or not on the PATH of its login shell.

cases.name: a pine without the service command

expect.message: The pine on {given} is too old to be reached this way: it has no "service" command. Update it there with "pine update", then try again.

cases.name: the command says why it ended
comment lines of a banner are left out
cases.stderr:
# welcome
# to the server
real trouble

expect.message: SSH to {given} ended (exit 3) without saying why.
{given} did not answer over SSH within a minute.

cases.name: it never answers and says something

expect.message: {given} did not answer over SSH within a minute. It said: hello

cases.name: Tailscale SSH asks the owner to sign in

expect.message: Tailscale SSH wants you to confirm it is you before {given} lets you in. Open https://login.tailscale.com/a/abc123, sign in, then try again.
